description.full: Checks Excel, Word, CSV or pasted text for personal data - names, PPS numbers, dates of birth, contact details, Eircodes, bank and card numbers, member/policy numbers and health details - and removes it. Get a clean copy safe for any AI tool (with a private key to put real values back), an anonymised copy for sharing, or an answer about your data without exposing anyone.
